findings.issue: User-supplied rule text written verbatim to decisions.md with no sanitization or length cap.

findings.issue: --quick --all --threshold 1 could mass-promote noise patterns. No validation floor on threshold.

findings.issue: Config blocks (decide, learning, retrospective) documented but absent from config.json.
findings.recommendation: Add 3 config blocks with documented defaults.

findings.issue: promotionThreshold defined in 4 places with no sync protocol.
findings.recommendation: Extract to single config key. Document 3 promotion paths.

findings.issue: Trigger phrase divergence between CLAUDE.md and wogi-decide.md.
findings.recommendation: Normalize trigger phrases to match exactly.

findings.issue: 4 conditional questions but cap is 3. No priority order for tiebreaking.
findings.recommendation: Add priority: Q1 > Q4 > Q3 > Q2.

findings.issue: Mode B calls bare /wogi-decide instead of --from-pattern.

findings.issue: --since parameter not validated against date regex.
